## Abstract

This presentation examines Smets and Wouters’ (2003) estimated dynamic stochastic general equilibrium model of the euro area. We explain the model’s structure and Bayesian estimation, compare its empirical performance with alternative specifications, and examine how different shocks contribute to fluctuations through variance decomposition. The discussion considers the findings and limitations of the framework.

## About this work

Joint presentation with **Lauri Hannikainen**, based on Frank Smets and Raf Wouters’ “An Estimated Dynamic Stochastic General Equilibrium Model of the Euro Area.”
